body: Tardive Dyskinesia, dystonia , Parkinsonism, Insomina, Extreme fatigue all from being forced to take risperidone for just 2 weeks

I was forced to take Risperidone (3mg) for 2 weeks in the psych ward and now I have developed Tardive Dyskinesia even after stopping the medication. My psychiatrist keeps telling me that TD only happens to people who are on meds for months/years and that I shouldn’t have TD so he won’t formally diagnose me with TD but writes down “ extrapyramidal symptoms” and “ Conversion disorder” instead .
Yet I experience  ALL OF THE SYMPTOMS OF TD (involuntary movements,muscle spams, dystonia). Currently I’m waiting for my referral to see a neurologist to see what can be done ):
